title: Cooper's UFO in orbit

tellings.quote: uh just that it had come uh in proximity with him and I think he said it was green if I'm not mistaken

plain: Gordon Cooper, an American astronaut, is said to have told of an object that came close to him while he was in orbit around the Earth in 1963, and Charlie Foltz thinks he said it was green. Foltz, who comes on the show as a witness in his own alien abduction story, is passing on what he recalls Cooper saying. If true, an astronaut met an unknown object in space.
